description:
Published **READMEs, operator guidance, and migration documentation** for the cutover.

## Owns

- Both package READMEs
- Beadwork `docs/` configuration/migration pages
- Root examples that mention delegate/tmux as current usage

## Does not own

- CLI aliases/completions (2.8)
- TUI copy (2.5)
- `/bw abandon` implementation (2.6) — document it here once it exists

## Content

- `/bw run` injects a prompt; standing appendix is policy
- Children die with Pi; stuck child may require process exit
- Shared-checkout coordination is advisory
- Removed flags/tools as **errors**, not ignored
- No landing.validateCommands gate
- Review policy ticket/scope/none
- Do not document tmux workers as current except in a Removed/Migration section

## Success criteria

- An operator who only reads README can run `/bw run EPIC` on tui with minions enabled.

## Test plan

- Grep: no current-tense tmux worker launch outside Migration.
- README states inject-prompt, process-local lifetime, advisory checkout.
title: Publish cutover README and migration notes
